af15d19f0c7df34e.description: About the Role TalentHunt is seeking a Cybersecurity Director to lead the organization's cybersecurity function. This full-time role involves developing and implementing cybersecurity strategies, policies, controls, and risk management frameworks to safeguard critical information assets, systems, networks, and digital services. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and implementation of the organization’s Cybersecurity Strategy, roadmap, and operating model. Establish, maintain, and oversee cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and controls across the organization. Lead cybersecurity risk management activities, including risk identification, assessment, treatment, and ongoing monitoring. Oversee the protection of information systems, networks, applications, data, and technology assets against cybersecurity threats. Lead cybersecurity incident response readiness and oversee response, recovery, and post-incident improvement activities. Oversee vulnerability management, security assessments, penetration testing, and remediation programs. Ensure compliance with applicable Saudi cybersecurity regulations, frameworks, controls, and requirements. Oversee cybersecurity risk assessments related to third-party vendors, technology providers, and external partners. Define cybersecurity KPIs and KRIs and provide regular cybersecurity risk and performance reporting to senior management and relevant committees. Develop and oversee cybersecurity awareness programs to strengthen the organization’s security culture. Collaborate with Technology, Risk Management, Business Continuity, Internal Audit, and other relevant functions to ensure an integrated approach to cybersecurity. Build, lead, and develop the cybersecurity team and strengthen its technical and leadership capabilities. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline. A Master’s degree is preferred. Strong professional experience in Cybersecurity or Information Security, including leadership or managerial experience. Strong experience across cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance, and incident management. Advanced knowledge of relevant Saudi and international cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and controls. Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent are preferred. Proven experience in leading cybersecurity programs and strategic initiatives and engaging with senior stakeholders. Required Skills Strong leadership capabilities. Proficiency in risk management. Effective decision-making skills. Strong stakeholder management abilities. Excellent executive communication skills. The position provides strategic oversight across the program portfolio, ensuring effective management of scope, schedule, cost, risks, resources, dependencies, benefits, and outcomes. The role owns the integrated program baseline and consolidated reporting framework, working closely with program sponsors, senior stakeholders, project managers, finance, procurement, business leads, and delivery partners to ensure transparency, control, and assurance throughout the program lifecycle. A minimum of 10 years of experience is required for this role. Key Responsibilities Establish and lead the Program Management Office (PMO) across complex programs or portfolios, defining operating models, governance structures, processes, standards, and templates. Provide leadership and support to project managers, PMO analysts, planners, and project controls professionals, ensuring consistent application of methodologies. Coordinate program mobilization, planning, delivery, transition, and closure activities, promoting accountability and continuous improvement. Establish program governance forums, decision-making structures, and escalation routes, preparing materials for program boards and executive reviews. Maintain governance calendars, decision logs, action trackers, and approval records, monitoring compliance with program controls and organizational policies. Lead program health checks, assurance reviews, and delivery assessments, ensuring active management of decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and changes. Establish and maintain integrated controls for scope, schedule, cost, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, changes, benefits, and quality, developing the integrated master schedule and program baseline. Lead program budget development, financial planning, forecasting, and cost control, monitoring expenditure and supporting investment decisions. Oversee program-wide risk, issue, dependency, assumption, and opportunity management, including program change control. Define program reporting requirements and produce accurate dashboards, performance reports, and executive summaries, consolidating reporting from various teams. Build effective relationships with sponsors, executives, project teams, and partners, facilitating workshops and communicating program status. Establish and maintain benefits management, tracking, and realization processes, monitoring alignment with strategic objectives. Program Controls and Financial Management Monitor program progress against approved scope, milestones, budget, and benefits. Develop program forecasts, delivery plans, recovery plans, and scenario analysis. Oversee progress measurement, performance management, earned value analysis, and trend reporting. Validate reported progress, cost data, forecasts, and delivery information. Monitor actual expenditure, commitments, accruals, benefits, funding profiles, and estimate-at-completion. Review financial variances and ensure corrective actions are developed and implemented. Identify financial risks, cost pressures, opportunities, and potential efficiency improvements. Risk, Issue, and Change Management Ensure risks and issues are assessed consistently for impact, probability, ownership, and mitigation. Lead the identification and management of cross-project dependencies and constraints. Monitor the cumulative impact of changes on program scope, timeline, cost, resources, and benefits. Escalate significant risks, issues, and decisions to the appropriate governance body. Reporting and Stakeholder Engagement Report on milestones, schedule performance, cost, risks, issues, dependencies, resources, changes, benefits, and overall program health. Identify trends, exceptions, emerging risks, and areas requiring executive intervention. Provide clear recommendations to support prioritization, decision-making, and corrective action. Manage stakeholder expectations and support resolution of complex delivery issues. Represent the program at organizational planning, assurance, and governance forums.

afed96cba6524fe4.job_title: Customer Service Lead Representitive Cigna Healthcare
afed96cba6524fe4.description: About Cigna Healthcare Cigna Healthcare is a global health service company committed to transforming healthcare. Serving over 180 million customers and patients worldwide, the company is recognized as a trusted and influential name in the industry. Cigna Healthcare's mission is to improve the health, well-being, and peace of mind of those it serves. Role Overview The Customer Service Lead Representative plays a critical role in supporting the delivery of customer service across member, provider, client, and broker interactions within the contact center. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, Riyadh, serves as a senior technical and operational resource. The role involves managing complex inquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery activities, while ensuring service continuity and adherence to service standards. This is not a formal people management role and does not include employee performance management or disciplinary authority. Key Responsibilities Investigate and resolve complex customer inquiries, complaints, appeals, and escalated service issues via various communication channels. Act as the primary operational and technical escalation point for cases requiring advanced research, coordination, policy interpretation, or procedural guidance. Interpret policy provisions, benefits, procedures, and operational requirements to determine appropriate solutions and escalation pathways. Maintain end-to-end ownership of escalated cases, ensuring timely resolution, accurate documentation, proactive follow-up, and clear customer communication. Support service recovery activities by managing customer expectations and coordinating corrective actions. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate prompt resolution of customer issues and build effective working relationships. Monitor service queues, pending inventories, backlogs, and service-level risks, escalating concerns to the Customer Service Supervisor. Support workload coordination and operational prioritization based on customer impact and business requirements. Ensure effective shift handovers through accurate communication of priority cases and operational updates. Assist with the preparation of operational updates, service-level reports, and risk visibility reporting. Identify recurring service issues, root causes, and process gaps, providing recommendations for improvement. Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives, onboarding activities, and quality improvement programs. Support quality assurance reviews, compliance activities, and operational governance requirements. Maintain accurate customer records and ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and data privacy standards. Provide designated operational support coverage during the absence of the Customer Service Manager, within defined authority limits. Qualifications and Experience Education: Diploma or Bachelor's degree, preferably in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Customer Service Management, or a related discipline. Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in customer service, member services, client services, or call center/contact center operations. Specialized Experience: Demonstrated experience managing complex customer inquiries, complaints, escalations, and service recovery situations. Experience within the healthcare insurance industry is strongly preferred; experience in insurance, managed care, banking, financial services, or third-party administration environments will also be considered. Required Skills Strong understanding of contact center operations, service levels, escalation management, workload prioritization, case ownership, and queue management principles. Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain service quality under pressure. Willingness to work flexible shifts in line with business requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Riyadh. The role operates within a contact center environment, requiring adaptability to varying contact volumes and operational peaks.

This involves leveraging digital services, EDI, API integration, and workflow management to achieve complete automation. Identify and implement new processes with full automation to meet evolving business and customer demands. Collaborate with Customers, IT, Operations, Customs, and other authorities to manage process enhancements and system developments, ensuring alignment with requirements and timely implementation. af1f70cbe90318df.description: About the Role Teef Najd Group is seeking a Quality Control Engineer to join their team in a full-time capacity. This role is responsible for ensuring the quality of all finishing, interior fit-out, natural stone, and marble installation works. The successful candidate will have 0-1 years of experience and will ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Inspect all architectural finishing and interior fit-out activities, including flooring, wall cladding, ceilings, gypsum works, painting, tiling, joinery, doors, and decorative finishes. Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, verticality, surface flatness, edge details, and overall finishing quality. Perform detailed inspections of natural stone and marble materials for type, color, veining, texture, thickness, dimensions, and consistency against approved samples. Inspect stone and marble slabs for defects such as cracks, chips, scratches, stains, and discoloration. Monitor stone and marble installation, ensuring correct setting-out, alignment, levelness, joint width, lippage control, and fixing systems. Prepare and submit Inspection Requests (IRs/WIRs) and coordinate inspections with consultants and client representatives. Maintain inspection records, checklists, material inspection reports, and non-conformance reports (NCRs). Raise NCRs for defective works and follow up on corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, stone suppliers, and project management teams. Review and inspect mock-ups and sample installations. Conduct final quality inspections of completed finishing, fit-out, stone, and marble works before handover. Finishing and Interior Fit-Out Quality Control This role involves ensuring that all architectural finishing and interior fit-out activities, including flooring, wall cladding, ceilings, gypsum works, painting, tiling, joinery, doors, and decorative finishes, comply with approved shop drawings, technical specifications, and material approvals. The Quality Control Engineer will verify dimensions, levels, alignment, verticality, surface flatness, and overall finishing quality, conducting site inspections at each stage to identify and address defects. Stone and Marble Quality Control The Quality Control Engineer will perform detailed inspections of natural stone and marble materials, verifying material type, color, veining, texture, thickness, dimensions, and finish against approved samples. Responsibilities include inspecting slabs for defects, verifying vein matching and layout patterns, and monitoring installation for correct setting-out, alignment, levelness, and joint consistency. The role also covers inspecting grouting, sealing, cleaning, and ensuring proper handling and protection of materials. Inspection and Quality Documentation A key aspect of this position is preparing and submitting Inspection Requests (IRs/WIRs) and coordinating inspections with consultants and client representatives. The Quality Control Engineer will review approved shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). Maintaining comprehensive inspection records, checklists, material inspection reports, and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) is essential, along with ensuring corrective actions are completed and documented through photographic records. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in quality control, preferably within architectural finishes, interior fit-out, or stone and marble installation. Strong technical expertise in architectural finishes, high-end interior fit-out, and stone and marble fabrication and installation. Ability to interpret shop drawings, project specifications, and material submittals. Proficiency in identifying quality issues, preventing defects, and ensuring compliance with project requirements.

af25fc2d5b823476.description: About Red Sea Security Red Sea Security, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, is dedicated to providing world-class, seamless, and invisible security services tailored for the tourism sector, aligning with the 2030 vision. The company operates in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj and Tabuk cities. The position also involves supporting pricing and margin analysis, as well as performance oversight, with the expectation that the focus will narrow as the team expands. af5e6a98b56931d7.description: About Lucid Motors Lucid Motors focuses on creating advanced mobility experiences through innovation, driving the automotive world forward. The company's vehicles are built on proprietary technology and a software-defined architecture, emphasizing a "Compromise Nothing™" approach that integrates performance, sustainability, design, and engineering. Lucid achieves this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production managed in-house across global facilities. The Role of Ergonomics Specialist Lucid Motors is seeking an Ergonomics Specialist to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of ergonomics programs. This full-time position is based in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The specialist will be responsible for identifying and mitigating musculoskeletal disorder (MSD) risks, improving workstation design, supporting operational readiness activities, and promoting ergonomic excellence through engineering controls, employee engagement, and data-driven improvements across manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, office, and construction support activities. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and continuously improve the site Ergonomics Management Program. Conduct ergonomic assessments of manufacturing workstations, warehouse activities, logistics operations, maintenance tasks, and office environments. Evaluate tasks using recognized ergonomic assessment tools such as RULA, REBA, the NIOSH Lifting Equation, Liberty Mutual Tables, Snook Tables, and OCRA. Identify ergonomic risk factors including repetitive motion, awkward postures, excessive force, contact stress, vibration exposure, and manual material handling activities. Lead ergonomic reviews during equipment design, process development, line modifications, and operational readiness activities. Collaborate with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, Logistics, and Industrial Engineering teams to integrate ergonomic principles into workplace design. Recommend and validate engineering controls to eliminate or reduce ergonomic risks. Participate in new equipment commissioning and ensure ergonomic requirements are incorporated into machine and workstation designs. Conduct workstation validations and support production ramp-up activities. Analyze injury, discomfort, and first aid data to identify trends and improvement opportunities. Lead investigations related to musculoskeletal injuries and develop corrective actions. Develop ergonomic standards, guidelines, and design specifications for manufacturing operations. Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, quality, and employee well-being. Deliver ergonomic awareness training and coaching for employees, supervisors, engineers, and leadership teams. Support industrial hygiene and occupational health programs where ergonomic risks intersect with worker health. Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure program effectiveness and risk reduction. Conduct periodic ergonomic audits and workplace inspections. Work closely with medical providers, occupational health personnel, and Human Resources regarding return-to-work and accommodation assessments. Support ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management system requirements related to workplace risk management and continuous improvement. Prepare reports, presentations, and business cases supporting ergonomic improvement projects. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Ergonomics, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Human Factors Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 4 years of experience in industrial ergonomics within manufacturing, automotive, logistics, warehousing, or heavy industrial environments. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working across various operational environments, including manufacturing, warehouse, logistics, office, and construction support activities, requiring collaboration with diverse teams.

Your job is to do the on-call/ops work like any SRE, then turn what you learn into agents — identify the workflow, build the agent, and earn the trust to let it act with increasing autonomy. What you'll do Carry a normal on-call rotation and act as a hands-on responder: investigate, fix, and document incidents yourself, exactly like any SRE on the team — especially for workflows that don' t have an agent yet. Go deep on application-level reliability, not just infrastructure: read and debug service code, understand business logic well enough to find the real root cause, and ship fixes or PRs directly into application repos when the fix belongs in the app, not the platform. Design, build, and ship LLM-based agents (using tools like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3) that plug into our existing stack: Kubernetes, cloud APIs, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Datadog, PagerDuty/Slack. Define the "tool" interface each agent needs — the specific APIs, scripts, and read/write actions — and build safe wrappers around them. Set clear guardrails for every agent: what it may do autonomously vs. what it must propose for human approval, with a bias toward human-in-the-loop until an agent has earned trust. Own agent evaluation — define what "correct" and "safe" look like per agent, and build test/backtest suites against real historical incidents. Continuously tune prompts, context, and tool schemas as an agent' s scope grows. Partner with the SRE/platform team to find good agent candidates: repetitive, well-scoped, auditable workflows. Report on agent impact — MTTD/MTTR/MTTX movement, false positive/negative rates, and engineer-hours of toil removed. Keep a security- and compliance-first posture: audit trails for every autonomous action, least-privilege access to production, and alignment with Saudi data residency/regulatory requirements. Requirements 3+ years building production software with LLMs — agentic workflows, tool/function calling, multi-step planning, RAG — not just personal use of a chat assistant. Hands-on experience shipping real work with an agentic coding tool such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Kimi K2/K3. Strong Python (or similar) for building agent tooling, API wrappers, and orchestration. Real, hands-on SRE experience: comfortable being a primary on-call responder, running incident response, and doing root cause analysis under pressure — not just familiar with the concepts. Application-level debugging skill, not just infra: able to read a service' s codebase, trace a failure back to the actual line/logic causing it, and ship a fix yourself — SRE work here isn' t limited to restarting pods or scaling nodes. Solid hands-on Kubernetes and cloud provider experience (AWS/GCP/OCI/Azure) and fluency with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK) — both as an operator and as integration points for agents. Understands guardrails for autonomous systems: permissioning, approval gates, rollback paths, auditability. Can build trust with technical stakeholders — every agent starts with limited autonomy and has to earn more. Nice to have Experience in Saudi Arabia / MENA, ideally consulting across public or private sector clients. Familiarity with Terraform/Ansible, Docker, VM/on-prem setups — useful context for the agents you' ll build, not the core job. Experience building eval/backtest harnesses for LLM agents against historical incident data. Background in ML engineering, LLMOps, or platform engineering.
